name: M6G
summary: Morphine-6-glucuronide (M6G) is a major active metabolite of morphine. M6G is formed from morphine by the enzyme UGT2B7. It has analgesic effects roughly half that of morphine. M6G can accumulate to toxic levels in kidney failure.

pharmacology.text: Morphine-6-glucuronide (M6G) is a major active metabolite of morphine.

uses.en: It is mainly important as a product of morphine in the body. It has been trialled as a painkiller in its own right but is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它主要的意義在於它是嗎啡在體內的產物。它曾被單獨試驗作為止痛藥，但並未成為核准的藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它主要的意义在于它是吗啡在体内的产物。它曾被单独试验作为止痛药，但并未成为核准的药品。

sideEffects.en: It causes opioid effects such as drowsiness, nausea and constipation, and it can slow breathing. Because the kidneys clear it, it can build up in kidney failure and cause dangerous sedation and breathing problems.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、噁心、便秘等鴉片類作用，也可能使呼吸減慢。由於它經由腎臟排出，腎衰竭時可能在體內累積，造成危險的鎮靜與呼吸問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、恶心、便秘等鸦片类作用，也可能使呼吸减慢。由于它经由肾脏排出，肾衰竭时可能在体内累积，造成危险的镇静与呼吸问题。

fact.en: The liver turns morphine into two main glucuronides. Morphine-3-glucuronide does not relieve pain, but morphine-6-glucuronide does, so part of morphine's pain relief actually comes from this metabolite.
fact.zh: 肝臟會把嗎啡轉換成兩種主要的葡萄糖醛酸苷。嗎啡-3-葡萄糖醛酸苷不能止痛，嗎啡-6-葡萄糖醛酸苷卻可以，所以嗎啡的止痛效果有一部分其實來自這個代謝物。
fact.zhHans: 肝脏会把吗啡转换成两种主要的葡萄糖醛酸苷。吗啡-3-葡萄糖醛酸苷不能止痛，吗啡-6-葡萄糖醛酸苷却可以，所以吗啡的止痛效果有一部分其实来自这个代谢物。
